common.scope_rule: A branch is a newly initialized disposable fixture instance of the exact reviewed root and explicitly replayed prefix, never reset/edited/cloned from an admitted active world. Cases run one at a time. Existing world/lineage strings, roots and canonical identities are not renamed; run ids distinguish independent installations. Counterfactuals are not appended to main.
common.qualified_root_rule: Use ROOT_BLUEPRINTS archive-relative descriptors + genuine qualified B1 data; all root/source/backend/profile/authority/identity hashes independently computed, no documentary opaque heads reused.
common.witness_rule: Before each new R use full current semantic and storage Witness from independently checked all-nine rows and external ack ledger. Every prepare/preview is pure. No old saved witness for a new operation.
common.wire_rule: Existing R/V/Preview/Submit/HookPlan closed schemas unchanged. Runtime bindings below mean exact bytes from identified current output slot; no filtered input summary or implicit V discard.

binding_grammar.$bind: Exact immutable value from named slot at JSON Pointer, empty pointer means whole value. A binding is an instruction for future reviewer/controller input construction, not a Core field. Slot must exist before use; no binding resolves from a future result.
binding_grammar.$hash: Exact existing registry algorithm/tag/value expression. Substitute already identified values then J/Htag; no additional domain, sorting or LF. No execution engine for this grammar is supplied.
binding_grammar.KEY: {world: selected unchanged descriptor.world,lineage:descriptor.lineage,producer:actual proposer.producer,incarnation:1,operation:exact run operation string}; result_id=operation+-result unless exact replay retained.
binding_grammar.SEND: Full CompileRequest/PreviewRequest/PrepareRequest from unchanged old contracts. Draft=literal entry. prepare uses supplied/internal mode as stated, payload={draft}, complete actual Preview. R is exact prepare output. Supplied V is exact pure proposal after independent expected-data validation. Expected files never enter production Choice.
binding_grammar.steps: Ordered documentary API invocations, not an executable test runner. Pure propose uses author-reader/1; submission always rechecks actual human-H/1 separately. Captures hold the API success_type VALUE itself: compile Outward, preview Preview, prepare R, propose V, submit/replay CommitAnswer, author read AuthorView. No imaginary R/V fields are read from CommitAnswer. context.descriptor is the run exact descriptor read from its immutable source; context is controller data, never an extra Core input.
binding_grammar.source_members: Any path referring to old baseline/b0-0.1 is a member of the carried immutable v011 ZIP. Selected exact member copies in sources/v011-members are for convenience only.

accepted_send_group_contract.baseline: Every before-set is independently derived from the explicitly selected original root/prefix; compare all actual raw typed key/payload rows, not just row counts. Existing TRANSPORT_AND_CONTROL per_kind_effects.send, record-id/effect-order and hash rules remain controlling. No new expected-effects engine is supplied.
accepted_send_group_contract.G1: Add only independently expected Comm initiating/reply outwards/claims, actual Receive records/grants, raw Choice input/decision/phases/context, and the one eligible first-credit Cog revision where declared. C1 has no Cog records/input/basis. Retained prior rows unchanged; no permission is performed as physical action.
accepted_send_group_contract.G2: Exact identities/bindings unchanged, no new or merged actor.
accepted_send_group_contract.G3: One semantic increment and one publication ordinal increment per accepted new Send; exact post semantic head from validated state. No extra increment for retry or read.
accepted_send_group_contract.G4: Clock/due[] unchanged at the run exact time.
accepted_send_group_contract.G5: Only complete required protection edges for the exact new received/source/record/receipt dependencies; prior required fidelity/edges retained. No new independent report root from repetition.
accepted_send_group_contract.G6: One exact fresh K record containing original immutable R/V/dependency/Dbody/Did. No overwrite/reservation for rejected K; no replacement of committed C03.
accepted_send_group_contract.G8: Exactly one full publication linked to previous current storage head, binding original receipt and complete non-G8 row manifest. No acknowledgment before commit.
accepted_send_group_contract.G9: Exact necessary serving/grant and prior-prefix coverage updates under existing rules; retain complete original proof, no implicit checkpoint payload, optional-loss waiver or read repair.
accepted_send_group_contract.exact_retry: All G1..G9 equal before/after; original D unchanged, no re-resolution or new receiving/phase/clock/publication.
accepted_send_group_contract.scope: This contract specifies expected positive deltas, not observed results. Future Tester must compute actual expected raw row bodies independently from pinned types/authored policy and scoped operation identities, not accept proposed V as its own oracle.

common.technical_evidence: Owner-controlled raw fault/capture observations are external diagnostic evidence, not admitted story state. Prepublication pure staging may be observed but cannot be installed, rendered as speech, or escape rollback. G1..G9 raw key/payload sets and Witness remain exactly the last acknowledged state; no compensation event.
common.runtime_numeric_caps: All eleven actual measured caps remain unknown and must be sealed/independently qualified in B1; no resource measurement performed.
common.pending_B1_playability: First B1 delivery must be fun as a standalone playable social-strategy experience as well as satisfy technical proofs. A separately reviewed scope/playability amendment is required BEFORE implementation authorization; headless GF02 alone is not gameplay acceptance.
